title: Bank Shot Bounce
brief: A billiards-style table seen from above. Drag back from your ball to aim; the longer the drag, the harder the shot. Balls bounce off the cushions and off each other. Sink the numbered balls in order for points; sinking your own ball costs a life. Each level changes the table: odd shapes, bumpers in the middle, pockets that slide along the rails, slick or sticky felt.
